title: Initial search state
statement: For natural numbers $n$, $s$, and $c_1$, let the initial search state be the state record with all fields zero except that its logarithm-bound field is set to the logarithm-bound value associated to $n$, its radius field to $s$, and its first-search count field to $c_1$.
